group.passage: For a history class project called “Old Things, Family Stories,” six students each brought an old object from home to school. They also wrote a short note about where the object came from and what it means to their family. Here are their notes.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Annie
passage_parts.text: This rice cooker is older than I am! My grandmother bought it when she first moved to Taipei. The paint is coming off, but it still works perfectly. She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Brian
passage_parts.text: This small cassette player belonged to my father. As a teenager, he carried it with him all the time and listened to his favorite songs on tapes. It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.

passage_parts.label: C
passage_parts.title: Claire
passage_parts.text: This sewing machine was a wedding gift to my grandmother. For many years, she made clothes for the whole family with it. Her eyes are not as good as before, so she gave up sewing. Now the machine just stands in a corner of our living room under a cloth.

passage_parts.label: D
passage_parts.title: Derek
passage_parts.text: My grandfather bought this camera before I was born. It needs film, so you can’t see your photos right away. You have to wait until the film is developed. My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.

passage_parts.label: E
passage_parts.title: Eva
passage_parts.text: My grandfather rode this heavy black bicycle to the market for many years. Last year, my uncle cleaned it and changed the tires. Now I ride it to school every morning. It is slow, but it has never broken down.

passage_parts.label: F
passage_parts.title: Felix
passage_parts.text: This old telephone used to sit in the hall of my grandfather’s house. To call someone, you had to turn a round dial once for each number. It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.

questions.stem:
下列簡短敘述摘記上方文章的重點。請從文章中找出兩個單詞（word），分別填入句子的空格中，並視句型結構需要做適當的字形變化，使句子語意完整、語法正確，並符合全文文意。每格限填一個單詞（word）。（填充題，4分）
Not all of the old objects are still in use. Some of them are just [[1]] by their families in a drawer or on a shelf. Brian’s father, for example, still has his old cassette player, which [[2]] him of his days at school.

下列簡短敘述摘記上方文章的重點。請從文章中找出兩個單詞（word），分別填入句子的空格中，並視句型結構需要做適當的字形變化，使句子語意完整、語法正確，並符合全文文意。每格限填一個單詞（word）。（填充題，4分）
Not all of the old objects are still in use. Some of them are just [[1]] by their families in a drawer or on a shelf. Brian’s father, for example, still has his old cassette player, which [[2]] him of his days at school.

Which students brought objects that their families still use today?
請選出學生名字前的英文大寫字母（如 A、B、C 等），並劃記在答題卷作答區內。（多選題，4分）
In Felix’s note, which noun means “the part of an old phone that you spin with your finger”?（簡答題，2分）

1.explanation_zh: Brian 的爸爸把壞掉的錄音機收在抽屜裡（keeps it in a drawer），Felix 家把不能用的電話放在架子上（keep it on a shelf）。空格前有 are、後有 by their families，是被動語態，要用過去分詞：keep → kept。
evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.
1.strategy_zh: 用 drawer、shelf 回到原文，找出把舊東西「收起來」的兩則；再看 are ___ by 是被動語態，把動詞改成過去分詞。
hints: are ___ by their families 是被動語態，要填過去分詞。
找出把舊東西「收在抽屜裡」或「放在架子上」的兩則說明。
原文是 keeps it in a drawer／keep it on a shelf；把 keep 改成過去分詞。

2.explanation_zh: Brian 說爸爸還留著錄音機，因為它讓爸爸想起學生時代（it reminds him of his school days）。空格的主詞 which 指 cassette player（單數），用現在式 reminds，和原文的字形相同，照抄即可。remind A of B＝讓 A 想起 B。
evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
2.strategy_zh: 空格後的 him of 是 remind A of B 的固定搭配；用 cassette player、father 回到 Brian 那則就能找到原字。
hints: 空格後有 him of，想想哪個動詞常用「___ 人 of 某事」的句型。
回到 Brian 那則，看爸爸為什麼還留著錄音機。
原文 because it ___ him of his school days；這個字照抄即可。

3.explanation_zh: 現在還在用的是 A（奶奶幾乎每天用這個電鍋煮飯）、D（爺爺在家庭聚餐和假日仍拿相機出來拍照）、E（Eva 每天早上騎這輛腳踏車上學）。B、C、F 的物品雖然都還「留著」（keeps、stands in a corner、keep），但已經壞掉或沒有人再用，只是收著當作回憶。
evidence: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.
Now I ride it to school every morning.

option_notes_zh.B: 錄音機很久以前就壞了（It stopped working a long time ago），爸爸只是收在抽屜裡當回憶，現在沒有在用。
option_notes_zh.C: 奶奶已經不再縫紉（she gave up sewing），縫紉機現在蓋著布放在客廳角落，沒有人在用。
option_notes_zh.F: 電話已經不能用了（It no longer works），只是放在架子上懷念過去。

3.strategy_zh: 分類題：先把題目條件（still use today）當作判斷標準，逐則找描述「現在」的句子（now、still、every day）；注意 keep（留著）不等於 use（使用）。
hints: 題目問的是「現在還在用」的物品，不是「還留著」的物品。
逐則找描述現在情況的句子，留意 still、now、every day 這些字。
已經壞掉、或只是收在抽屜、角落、架子上的物品都不能選。

A: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
B: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
C: Her eyes are not as good as before, so she gave up sewing.
Now the machine just stands in a corner of our living room under a cloth.
D: My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.
E: Now I ride it to school every morning.
F: It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.

4.explanation_zh: Felix 說用這支老電話打給別人時，每撥一個號碼都要轉一次圓形的 dial（撥號盤）。dial 就是舊式電話上用手指轉動來撥號的圓盤。題目限定名詞，只寫 dial，不必連 round 一起抄。
evidence: To call someone, you had to turn a round dial once for each number.
4.strategy_zh: 依英文定義找字：題目限定名詞、限定 Felix 那則；找老電話上「用手指轉動」的部分，只寫那個名詞。
hints: 要找一個名詞，指老電話上用手指轉動的那個部分。
看 Felix 那則：以前打電話時，每撥一個號碼要轉動什麼？
答案在 you had to turn a round ___ once for each number。

translation_zh.text:
【引言】在一個名為「老物件，家庭故事」的歷史課專題中，六位學生各自從家裡帶了一件老東西到學校，並寫了一段簡短的說明，介紹這件物品從哪裡來、對家人有什麼意義。以下是他們的說明。
【A Annie】這個電鍋比我還老！我奶奶剛搬到台北時買了它。它的漆正在剝落，但還是非常好用。奶奶幾乎每天都用它煮飯，還說沒有一個新電鍋煮出來的飯有這麼好吃。
【B Brian】這台小小的卡帶隨身聽是我爸爸的。他十幾歲時隨時帶著它，用卡帶聽他最喜歡的歌。它很久以前就壞了，但爸爸還是把它收在抽屜裡，因為它讓他想起學生時代。
【C Claire】這台縫紉機是我奶奶的結婚禮物。好多年來，她用它替全家人做衣服。她的眼睛不如從前，所以已經不再縫紉了。現在這台縫紉機只是蓋著一塊布，放在我們家客廳的角落。
【D Derek】這台相機是我爺爺在我出生前買的。它要用底片，所以拍完不能馬上看到照片，必須等底片沖洗出來。爺爺在家庭聚餐和假日時，還是會把它拿出來幫我們拍照。
【E Eva】我爺爺騎著這輛笨重的黑色腳踏車去市場騎了很多年。去年，我叔叔把它清理乾淨，還換了輪胎。現在我每天早上騎它上學。它騎起來很慢，但從來沒有壞過。
【F Felix】這支老電話以前放在我爺爺家的走廊上。要打電話給別人，每撥一個號碼都得轉一次圓形撥盤。它已經不能用了，所以我們只是把它放在架子上，懷念過去的日子。

evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.
1.explanation_zh: are just ___ by 是被動語態，需要過去分詞；文中 keep 放在抽屜、架上，改成 kept。

evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
2.explanation_zh: remind sb. of sth.；主詞是單數 cassette player、句子是現在式，用 reminds。

evidence: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
3.explanation_zh: Annie 的電鍋、Derek 的相機、Eva 的腳踏車仍在使用；Brian 與 Felix 的東西壞了，Claire 的奶奶已不再縫紉。

A: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
D: My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.
E: Now I ride it to school every morning.

evidence: To call someone, you had to turn a round dial once for each number.
4.explanation_zh: dial 是舊式電話上用手指轉動的撥號盤。

evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.
1.explanation_zh: 句子是被動語態（are just ___ by their families），文中的 keep 要改成過去分詞 kept。

evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
2.explanation_zh: which 引導的關係子句，主詞是單數的 cassette player，現在式動詞用 reminds。

evidence: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.
Now I ride it to school every morning.
3.explanation_zh: Annie 的電鍋、Derek 的相機、Eva 的腳踏車目前仍在使用；Brian 的錄音機、Felix 的電話已壞，Claire 的縫紉機也不再使用。

A: She cooks rice in it almost every day and says no new cooker makes rice taste as good.
D: My grandfather still takes it out at family dinners and on holidays to take pictures of us.
E: Now I ride it to school every morning.

evidence: To call someone, you had to turn a round dial once for each number.
4.explanation_zh: Felix 的筆記說要轉動圓形的 dial 來撥號，符合「舊電話上用手指轉動的部分」。

B.evidence: It stopped working a long time ago, but my father keeps it in a drawer because it reminds him of his school days.
B.explanation_zh: 與明文矛盾（CT）：Brian 的錄音機很久以前就壞了，爸爸只是收在抽屜裡當紀念，現在沒有在用。

C.evidence: Her eyes are not as good as before, so she gave up sewing.
C.explanation_zh: 與明文矛盾（CT）：奶奶已經不再縫紉，縫紉機現在蓋著布放在客廳角落，沒有人在用。

F.evidence: It no longer works, so we just keep it on a shelf to remember the old days.
F.explanation_zh: 與明文矛盾（CT）：電話已經不能用，只放在架子上懷念過去，不是還在使用。
